title: Implement the native SFace Photo adapter

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: SFace adapter tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_sface_adapter.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed the exact image-backed mypy, focused SFace adapter and Memory Bank lint gates. A verifier-owned probe proved the configured OpenCV factory seam and YuNet-to-alignCrop-to-SFace call path, immutable revision and asset-set identity, native-result preservation, exact embedding dimension and L2 normalization, FaceEngine compliance, and early rejection of Buffalo or mismatched inputs without plugin, download or auto-selection behavior.

The autopilot scheduler closed TASK-019 after Execution Attempt 1 and fresh independent T2 verification PASS for the native YuNet-to-alignCrop-to-SFace Photo path, immutable revision/assets, exact dimension and normalization, FaceEngine compliance and accepted anti-goals. Two bounded execution fixes and one tooling-only overlay base-resolution recovery occurred before verdict; no task failure budget was consumed.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-007 RED: no production SFace Photo adapter exposes the accepted YuNet plus alignCrop/SFace path with revision and dimension checks; GREEN: one deterministic synthetic Photo follows that exact native path, returns a normalized dimension-valid embedding and rejects mismatched or Buffalo-derived inputs; decisive comparison: recorded native calls, revision metadata and negative fixtures match the AC; artifact: focused adapter-test output and redacted call-path record.
purpose: Implement the accepted native OpenCV SFace Photo path behind the existing processing-owned engine boundary.
success_outcome: An eligible SFace revision processes a synthetic Photo through YuNet, alignCrop and SFace with exact revision/dimension checks and no Buffalo M data path.
anti_goals: Do not implement realtime queries, a generic plugin system, model download or Buffalo M behavior.
Do not normalize the two engine-native bbox, landmark, crop or alignment contracts into one invented format.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The native path would require a second engine abstraction, online model download or automatic adapter selection.
Configured SFace assets cannot be validated against the immutable revision without changing the accepted contract.

constraints: Use one direct SFace implementation behind the existing FaceEngine boundary.
Model assets are configured and verified; execution never downloads or silently substitutes them.
Deterministic tests may inject native-call fixtures but must exercise the production adapter path.
invariants: SFace consumes only its YuNet/alignCrop-native result path.
Embedding dimension and asset identity match the immutable revision.
No Buffalo M intermediate is accepted.
verification_targets: Synthetic adapter proof records the YuNet, alignCrop and SFace call sequence plus normalized embedding and mismatch rejection.
